context_for_next_testing_agent: Bulk Status Actions feature fully tested. Key endpoint: POST /api/intake/sessions/{session_id}/bulk-action with BulkActionRequest model (item_ids, action, value). Actions: set_status (needs_info/in_review/ready), set_category, add_tags. Validation guards: (1) items with 3+ duplicate_flags skipped when marking ready, (2) items without clean_title/short_description/category skipped when marking ready. Response includes updated/skipped counts and skipped_items with reasons. Tag deduplication preserves order (existing tags first). Frontend has checkboxes on each row, select-all checkbox, bulk action bar with status buttons and inline inputs for category/tags. SHEIN session e54de4dc-5308-4b63-b1e1-f9af5f7d3225 has 63 items: 62 ready, 1 in_review (White Fishnet Bodysuit with 3 duplicate flags).

request_body.item_ids: list[str] - IDs of items to update
request_body.value: str - status name, category name, or comma-separated tags

set_status_ready.missing_fields: Skips items without clean_title, short_description, category, or price

tag_deduplication.behavior: Preserves order: existing tags first, then new tags
